html:
Lab size, from everyone alone to one lab of everyone, on a graph where deeper ideas are easier (1 bit fewer per level)

Question: On a graph where deeper ideas are easier (1 bit fewer per level), with 24 agents in labs of 1 to 24 that share inside the lab, how much money does the field need, against OSO across the whole field?

Answer: At budgets 8–16: best Traditional (α = 1, β = 0), alone (7 measures). At budget 32: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste; no clear difference on money to the main level. At budget 64: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste; no clear difference on hardest level and money to the main level. At budgets 128–65536: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved and bounty value. (Compared at each budget; 8 measures, a clear difference is more than 2.7 standard errors.)
